ValueSet: eHDSI Agent or Allergen With Exceptions

Official URL: https://ncez.mzcr.cz/terminology/ValueSet/AllergenWithExceptions Version: 1.0.0
Standards status: Trial-use Maturity Level: 2 Computable Name: AllergenWithExceptions

Copyright/Legal: This value set includes content from SNOMED CT, which is copyright © 2002+ International Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO), and distributed by agreement between IHTSDO and HL7. Implementer use of SNOMED CT is not covered by this agreement

The Value Set is used for coding s specific allergen or other agent/substance (drug, food, chemical agent, etc.) to which the patient has an adverse reaction propensity. It is defined as the union of: (a) eHDSIAllergenNoDrug (b) DLP_lecivePripravky (c) DLP_ATC (d) eHDSIAbsentOrUnknownAllergy (e) eHDSIExceptionalValue

References

This value set is not used here; it may be used elsewhere (e.g. specifications and/or implementations that use this content)

Logical Definition (CLD)

Language: cs

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Import all the codes that are contained in eHDSI Allergen No Drug
  • Import all the codes that are contained in Léčivé přípravky
  • Import all the codes that are contained in Český číselník ATC skupin
  • Import all the codes that are contained in eHDSI Absent Or Unknown Allergy
  • Import all the codes that are contained in eHDSI Exceptional Value
